description: Two phone-only capabilities. Haptic feedback on the few moments where something is handed to you, taken away, or arrives for you (the list lives in lib/haptics.ts). The plugin ships no `default` permission set, so the two commands are allowed by name. There is no desktop equivalent, and the frontend gates every call on a coarse pointer and swallows failures. And the camera, for reading the QR another device is showing when adding a device; a refused camera is an ordinary state and leaves typing the code as a complete path.
